numberedSourceClaims.text: A function is a named, reusable block of code defined with def that runs only when it is called; variables created inside it are local to that call.
A function is defined with the def keyword, a name, parentheses, and a colon, with an indented body.

A variable created outside any function has global scope and can be accessed anywhere in the program.

numberedSourceClaims.text: In music, harmony is the concept of combining different sounds in order to create new, distinct musical ideas.
In these genres, chord progressions are the defining feature on which melody and rhythm are built.
Chord progressions are the foundation of harmony in Western musical tradition from the common practice era of classical music to the 21st century.
A first chord forms a 'progression' with a second chord, and a second with a third.
For example, the relative minor of C major is A minor, and in the key of A minor, the i, iv and v chords are A minor, D minor and E minor.
In many styles of popular and traditional music, chord progressions are expressed using the name and "quality" of the chords.
